title: 🥇 Ultimate Hypertrophy Program
desc:
The Ultimate Hypertrophy Program is a 16-week intermediate training program built around evidence-based hypertrophy principles.

The split combines Heavy Push/Pull/Legs sessions with higher-volume Upper/Lower sessions to optimize both mechanical tension and training volume throughout the week.

The program emphasizes:

• Progressive overload through double progression

• Balanced weekly volume for every major muscle group

• Smart exercise selection with minimal overlap and fatigue

• Strategic supersets to improve training efficiency without compromising performance

• RPE-based intensity to promote sustainable long-term progress

Every exercise includes recommended rep ranges, intensity targets, rest periods and coaching notes to ensure consistent execution.

Designed for intermediate lifters training 5 days per week with access to a full commercial gym.
